pages.text: Twelve eyes open the End. They don't finish the story.$(br2)The Crown was broken into four pieces, each kept by one of the hardest foes in the world:

$(li)$(l:end/crown#crown_band)Band of the Crown$(/l): the Underworld Knight$(li)$(l:end/crown#crown_jewel)Jewel of the Crown$(/l): the Void Blossom$(li)$(l:end/crown#crown_crest)Crest of the Crown$(/l): the Wither$(li)$(l:end/crown#crown_setting)Setting of the Crown$(/l): the Harbinger
The $(l:end/crown#dragons_heart)Dragon's Heart$(/l) binds them into $(l:end/crown#kings_crown)The King's Crown$(/l). Whoever wears it will understand why it was broken.
